request.pr_body:
Closes aihub#131.

Annotation add / reply / resolve on the `/ui` artifact viewer used a form POST and
a 303 full-page reload. They now update the annotation layer in place.

## Approach — option ① PJAX-lite, zero new server routes

rejected: it grows five handlers a second response shape for the same user-visible
